title: list_service_refs input
description: Input for `list_service_refs`. URL literals that name a declared service, per repo. Live view only.

usage.description: Filter by where the literal lives.

outcome.description: Filter by what the host identifies.

suggestions.description: Also return suggested routes for production references that match no route of their service. Suggestions are proposals with a score, never links. Needs an installed embedding model.

min_score.description: Lowest score a suggestion may have. Default 0.6.
